        ### Question
        Question linked to image No. 1 In the same patient, from the observation of the chest x-ray, it can be deduced:

        ### Options

opb. Suspected nosocomial pneumonia.
opc. A failure (dehiscence) of the colonic anastomosis should be considered.
opd. Suspicion of PET
ope. You have an infection of the surgical wound.

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Presence of multiple nodules in the lungs on chest x-ray" -> "Consideration of pulmonary metastases" -> 70% CHAIN: "New infiltrate on chest x-ray" -> "Suspicion of nosocomial pneumonia" -> 80% CHAIN: "Abnormal gas pattern around the colonic anastomosis on chest x-ray" -> "Consideration of colonic anastomosis dehiscence" -> 75% CHAIN: "Detection of abnormal uptake on PET scan" -> "Suspicion of PET activity" -> 85% CHAIN: "Erythema, warmth, and purulent discharge at the surgical wound site" -> "Possibility of infection of the surgical wound" -> 70%

        ### Instructions:
        1. Recall standard consensus facts relevant to the question.
